scope: Selected August enrollment/waiver reconciliation and administrative paper notice distribution; no new benefit formula, clinical record, premium, employee deduction or cash. This is a company-held synthetic source, not real insurer evidence.

notice_documents.text: Your August election is recorded separately from payroll. Contact the existing benefit administrator to inspect or correct your enrollment. The employer receives enrollment status and aggregate premium information, not claims or diagnoses. Send clinical questions and claims to the insurer. You may request this administrative notice on paper without charge. No waiver of privacy rights or retaliation for a complaint is permitted. This notice does not change insured benefits, premiums or eligibility terms.

Loss of employment or reduction in hours can create continuation-coverage rights when coverage is lost. Notify the benefit administrator promptly of family changes affecting coverage. The administrator supplies the case-specific election notice and deadlines; an employment exit does not itself establish a COBRA election or payment. Other group coverage may offer special enrollment after loss of coverage. Request the applicable coverage documents from the administrator; this information does not waive statutory rights or establish that a later event already occurred.

administrative_review.payment_bridge: Existing health/welfare administration component remains unchanged; enrollment is not a second payroll expense.

september_exit.reason: Fourteen days after separate administrator notification; conservative earlier date retained despite later coverage loss. No gross misconduct authored; no dependent beneficiary population.

limitations: These two administrative notices are not mislabeled a full SPD or SBC. Existing insured coverage terms are not rewritten.

Insurer clinical claims adjudication/control effectiveness and a complete annual ERISA filing are outside the selected administrative evidence; no small-plan exemption inferred from fully insured status.
August coverage enrollment does not establish beginning-of-plan-year participant count. Annual Form5500 duty must use that separate period population.
